title: August 2026 Release
tagline: Copilot, Resume Studio, security hardening & mobile polish
headline: What's new in Career-Ops
subheadline: Copilot, Resume Studio, and a more reliable dashboard: here's what changed.

features.title: Career Copilot
features.summary: Chat with an AI that knows your profile, targeting keywords, and resume context.
features.detail: Draft LinkedIn outreach, prep interview answers, spot skill gaps, and get role-specific advice, powered by Mistral AI with OpenRouter fallback.

features.title: Resume Studio
features.summary: Live ATS preview, JD match scoring, and one-click tailored PDFs.
features.detail: Edit your master resume with real-time preview, match against job descriptions, save tailored versions per role, and export polished PDFs cached in the cloud.

features.title: Saved tailored resumes
features.summary: Re-open generated docs without re-running the AI pipeline.
features.detail: Your tailored resumes and PDFs are stored securely, so you can load them instantly from Generated Docs or Resume Studio.

features.title: Mobile-ready dashboard
features.summary: Works smoothly on iPhone and Android.
features.detail: Hamburger nav, safe-area layouts, touch-friendly inputs, and auto-scaling resume preview on smaller screens.

features.title: Hardened auth & rate limits
features.summary: Login lockout, OTP protection, and API quotas.
features.detail: Brute-force protection on login, per-email OTP limits, Copilot/PDF/terminal rate limits, and optional Cloudflare Turnstile on signup.

features.title: Admin registry
features.summary: User analytics and visitor insights for platform admins.
features.detail: See verified users, job counts, newsletter opt-ins, and traffic stats from one admin panel.

features.title: careerops.dpdns.org
features.summary: Custom domain with verified email delivery.
features.detail: Production runs on your branded domain with Brevo-authenticated sender for OTP and newsletters.

features.title: Interview Practice IDE
features.summary: Live in-browser code editor with instant test runner and AI DSA Handbook.
features.detail: Practice coding and system design interview questions directly in your dashboard with split-view tests, time complexity analysis, and instant feedback.

features.title: 3-Column Pipeline Studio
features.summary: Target discovery, live match scores, and application Kanban.
features.detail: Scan top Global Capability Centers (GCCs), review AI match scores, and drag applications across your 5-stage hiring funnel.

features.title: Referral links
features.summary: Invite friends, and they land on signup with your code pre-filled.
features.detail: Every user gets a unique referral code. Share it from Settings or your monthly email.
